title: MrBeast's birth chart
metaDescription: MrBeast's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 16.9° Taurus. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Across the nine placements whose signs are settled, fixed leads with four. Fixed signs hold the middle of their seasons, and a fixed-heavy chart is read as one that consolidates and does not easily let go.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 16.9° Taurus, deep enough in the second decan (10° to 20°) that Mercury, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 20.6° Aries, Venus at 4.4° Aries, Mars at 18.2° Taurus. Mercury in a fire sign reads as thought that arrives already in motion; Venus in a fire sign reads as attraction declared rather than implied; Mars in an earth sign reads as effort banked steadily until it tells.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The Sun and Mars hold the closest angle here, a conjunction, 1.2° wide. A conjunction is the least negotiable aspect in the scheme. There is no distance to argue across, so the pair arrives as a single instinct. Behind it, Venus sextile Neptune at 2.3°, and Mars sextile Jupiter at 2.6°, both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: No closed figure (no grand trine, t-square, or grand cross) holds among the day-stable angles. The chart distributes its tension pair by pair rather than through one standing structure.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks four placements here. Venus in Aries at 4.4° is in detriment (the planet opposite its home, working against the grain); Mars in Taurus at 18.2° is in detriment; Jupiter in Pisces at 20.8° is in domicile (the planet in its own sign, running on home rules); Saturn in Aries at 26.4° is in fall (the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given). Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Of the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: 4 in fire, 2 in earth, 2 in air, 1 in water by element, 4 fixed, 3 cardinal, 2 mutable by modality. Neptune and Pluto were retrograde (the optical reversal the tradition reads as review: energy turned over before it is turned out).

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Virgo into Libra during that day at the birthplace, travelling 11.8° between one midnight and the next. Half the day belongs to each sign, and the split falls at an unrecorded hour, so this page holds the Moon as a genuine unknown.
